verdict.rationale: PostHog Workflows let users define event-based triggers with delays, audience splits, message sends and PostHog actions, all running on the events and person properties already sent to PostHog. CDP realtime destinations add event, property or SQL filters, generic webhooks and editable Hog code, and Hog functions can be written by PostHog AI. For the AI-native angle, the MCP server exposes a 30-tool Workflows category, so agents can manage these rules too. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that event-triggered workflows and destinations work as documented.
